newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Livingston Manor CSD, N.Y.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Livingston Manor CSD, N.Y.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF BOND SALE
Livingston Manor Central School District
(Delaware, Sullivan and Ulster Counties)
New York
School District (Serial) Bonds, 1997
(Book-Entry Bonds)

Sealed proposals will be received by Livingston Manor Central School District at the office of Sullivan & Donovan, LLP, 415 Madison Avenue, 16th Floor, New York, New York 10017, at 12:00 Noon, Prevailing time on the
23th day of April 1997
for the purchase at not less than par plus accrued interest of the $1,250,000 aggregate principal amount of serial bonds herein described.

Interest on the Bonds will be payable April 15, 1998, and semiannually thereafter on October 15 and April 15 in each year to maturity. The Bonds mature on April 15 in the years and corresponding principal amounts as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

At the option of the bidder, the bidder may prescribe the principal maturities of the Bonds which shall mature by their stated terms on April 15 in each year, the first of such principal payments to commence April 15, 1999. Such maturities shall be due annually to and including April 15, 2012 so that the maximum amount of principal and interest on the Bonds payable in any calendar year shall not exceed the smallest of such amounts of principal and interest payable in any prior year by more than the greater of five (5%) percent or $10,000.

The Bonds maturing on or before April 15, 2006 will not be subject to redemption prior to maturity. The Bonds maturing on or after April 15, 2007 will be subject to redemption prior to maturity on not less than thirty (30) day's notice as a whole or in part (and by lot if less than all of a maturity is to be redeemed) at the option of the School District on April 15, 2006 or on any interest payment date thereafter at redemption prices, plus accrued interest to the date of redemption, as follows: April 15, 2006 and October 15, 2006, 102%, April 15, 2007 and October 15, 2007, 101%, and April 15, 2008 and thereafter, 100%.

The Bonds will be initially issued in registered form in denominations such that one bond shall be issued for each maturity of Bonds or such amounts as set forth herein and when issued will be registered in the name of Cede & Co., as nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, which will act as securities depository for the Bonds. The
Bonds may not be converted into coupon bonds or registered to bearer.
The Bonds will be designated as
qualified tax-exem
obligations'' pursuant to Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.

Each bid must be for all of the $1,250,000 serial bonds and may state different rates of interest for bonds maturing in different calendar years; provided, however, that (i) only one rate of interest may be bid for all Bonds maturing in any one calendar year, (ii) the maximum difference between the highest and lowest rates may not exceed one and one-half per centum (1.50%), and (iii) all rates of interest bid must be stated in a multiple of one-eighth or one- hundredth of one per centum per annum. Unless all bids are rejected, the award will be made to the bidder complying with the terms of this Notice of Sale provided, however, that the School District reserves the right, in its sole discretion, after selecting the lowest bidder, to adjust the aforestated maturity installments to the extent necessary to meet the requirements of substantially level or reclining debt service. Any such adjustment by the School District shall be conclusive and shall be binding upon the successful bidder. The right is reserved to reject any or all bids, and any bid not complying with the official Notice of Sale will be rejected. The right is further reserved to waive any
irregularity in the form of any bid if, in the judgement of the School District Supervisor, such waiver would not materially affect the integrity of the bidding process.

The Bonds will be awarded and sold to the bidder complying with the terms of sale and offering to purchase such issue of Bonds at such rate or rates of interest per annum as will produce the lowest net interest cost over the life of such issue and, if two or more such bidders offer the same lowest true interest cost, then to one of said bidders selected by the Sale Officer by lot from among all said bidders. Net interest cost being the lowest interest cost over the life of the Bonds after deducting the premium, if any.

Each bid must be enclosed in a sealed envelope addressed to the undersigned President of the Board of Education, c/o Sullivan & Donovan, LLP, 415 Madison Avenue, 16th Floor, New York, New York 10017, and should be marked on the outside Proposal for Bonds'' and must be accompanied by a

certified or cashier's check drawn upon an incorporated bank or trust company to the order of Livingston Manor School District, New York, for $25,000 as a good faith deposit to secure the School District against any loss resulting from the failure of the bidder to comply with the terms of its bid or to be retained as liquidated damages in the event of the failure of the purchaser to accept delivery of and pay for the Bonds. No interest will be allowed on the amount of the good faith deposit.
The Bonds will be delivered at New York, New York, or at such other place as may be agreed upon with the purchaser, on or about May 7, 1997, against payments in Federal Funds

to the School District in an amount equal to the par of the Bonds, plus the premium bid, if any, plus accrued interest from the date of the Bonds to the day of delivery and payment therefor, less amount of the good faith deposit submitted with the bid and collected by the School District. Upon delivery of and payment for the Bonds, the purchaser will be furnished without cost with the approving opinion of Messrs. Sullivan & Donovan, LLP, of New York, New York, Bond Counsel to the School District.

Copies of said Notice of Sale and the Official Statement may be promptly obtained from Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc., Cicero Professional Building, Suite 112, 6221 Route 31, Cicero, New York 13039, telephone (315) 699-7912, Additional Official Statements may be downloaded from Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc.'s Internet address:
http://www.fiscaladvisors.com.
Dated: April 11, 1997
President of the Board of Education
(From The Bond Buyer)
